examples.en: Eliot, a man fascinated by the "presence" of the past, wrote the most innovative poetry of his time.
examples.zh: 艾略特对过去的“存在”着迷，写下了他那个时代最具创新性的诗歌。

examples.en: Washington University in Saint Louis was named Eliot Seminary when it opened in eighteen fifty-three.
examples.zh: 位于圣路易斯的华盛顿大学在1853年成立时被命名为艾略特学院。

examples.en: In English, it begins with the late novels of Henry James around 1900, in poetry with Eliot and with Ezra Pound.
examples.zh: 在英语中，它始于1900年前后亨利·詹姆斯的晚期小说，和艾略特和艾兹拉·庞德的诗歌。
